name: booking-bandit
description: Drafts Instagram DM replies in a coach's own voice, so more conversations turn into booked calls without living in the inbox. This is the v0.0.1 skeleton release: the catalog entry, the plugin structure and one reserved placeholder skill, with no drafting logic in it yet. The drafting agent that carries the reply rules and DM knowledge base, plus the setup, inbox-polling, send and tuning skills, land in later releases.
